verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a changelog line that mentions HOTP entries, which implies HOTP codes are supported. Nothing in the pack covers Steam Guard, custom periods or custom digit lengths, so this is glancing support for one of the four token types. Missing for 10: Steam Guard support evidence, documented HOTP counter handling, custom period configuration, custom digit-length configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, non-standard tokens work too — Steam Guard, HOTP counters, custom periods and digit lengths

citations.quote: Sharing is now limited to TOTP codes; the share option is hidden for HOTP entries.
